name: room-climate-card
description: Build and test tooling for the Room Climate Card Home Assistant custom card. Sources live in src/ (ES modules); the card ships as a single, dependency-free bundle, built to dist/room-climate-card.js and published as the GitHub release asset HACS installs. It does not require any of this tooling to run in Home Assistant.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:run && npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:run
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:unit:run
scripts.test:unit:verbose: npm run build && npm run test:unit:verbose:run
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.test:fuzz: npm run build && npm run test:fuzz:run
